about: Phase 0 evaluation fixtures for schedule import (ROADMAP Apple Intelligence track, D-039). Synthetic text samples written to mirror real posts; replace or extend with real flyers, CNR sheets and GroupMe posts as the owner collects them. Times are local wall-clock (no time zone). 'referenceDate' is 'today' for relative dates like 'this Saturday'. An expected end of null means the source gave none.
